effect.clanginghowl.attraction.descripti: 20 格内的实体会跟随效果持有者，怪物则会将其作为攻击目标。（Entities within 20 blocks will follow, or target if monster, the affected.）
effect.clanginghowl.beyond_flesh.descrip: 部分效果持有者会在效果即将结束时转变为机械血肉生物。（Certain affected will transform into a techno-flesh creature after effect nearly finishes.）
effect.clanginghowl.cosmic_irradiation.d: 最大生命值降低 15%%，攻击伤害降低 10%%；效果等级越高，降幅越大。（Decreases max health by 15%% and attack damage by 10%%; higher levels decreases further.）
effect.clanginghowl.deep_burn.descriptio: 受到的火焰伤害增加 60%%。（Increases incoming fire damage by 60%%.）
effect.clanginghowl.enlightened.descript: 效果持有者会发出绿色光芒，受到的物理伤害增加 30%%。（Affected will glow green and receive 30%% more damage from physical damage.）
effect.clanginghowl.internal_heat.descri: 产生不破坏方块的爆炸，使其他实体着火并获得此效果。（Emits non-destructive explosion that gives effect, and sets fire, to other entities.）
effect.clanginghowl.neurotoxin.descripti: 移动时持续受到伤害；效果等级越高，每秒伤害越高。（Inflicts damage over time, when moving; higher levels do more damage per second.）
effect.clanginghowl.overdrive.descriptio: 近战伤害增加 4，移动速度增加 45%%。（Increases melee damage by 4 and movement speed by 45%%.）
effect.clanginghowl.sawing_up_health.des: 最大生命值降低 5%%；效果等级越高，降幅越大。（Decreases max health by 5%%; higher levels decreases further.）
effect.clanginghowl.weakened_defense.des: 护甲值降低 40%%；效果等级越高，降幅越大。（Decreases armor by 40%%; higher levels decreases further.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.chain_burn.desc: 适用于火焰喷射器。使实体获得内热效果，在死亡时产生爆炸，并将此效果传递给附近的其他实体。（Applies to Flamethrowers. Gives entities Internal Heat that will cause them to emit a blast upon death that gives effect to other nearby entities.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.ecological_ener: 适用于所有高级工具。持有者直接暴露于阳光下时会被动充能。持有者遭到雷击时充入 400 能量。（Applies to all advanced tools. Passively charges when the holder is exposed to direct sunlight. When the holder is struck by lightning, charges 400 energy）
enchantment.clanginghowl.energy_efficien: 适用于所有高级工具。每级减少 1 点能量消耗。（Applies to all advanced tools. For each level, reduces energy consumption by one.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.exceeding_the_l: 适用于高级链锯剑。近战伤害增加 0.5，并将生命锯削效果的最高叠加等级提高至 10。（Applies to Advanced Chainswords. Increase melee damage by 0.5 and increases max Sawing Up Health effect level stack to 10.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.fuel_burst.desc: 适用于火焰喷射器。将喷射方式改为短促爆发，对实体造成伤害并将其推开。增加燃料消耗。（Applies to Flamethrowers. Change the Flamethrower to only shoot a short burst that damages and pushes away entities. Increases fuel consumption.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.fuel_saving.des: 适用于火焰喷射器。每级减少 1 点燃料消耗。（Applies to Flamethrowers. For each level, reduces fuel consumption by one.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.full_power.desc: 适用于高级链锯。使用时会快速伤害前方的敌人，并逐渐过热。增加能量消耗。（Applies to Advanced Chainsaws. Makes chainsaw to rapidly damage enemies in front when using it, slowly causing it to overheat. Increases energy consumption.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.killer_charge.d: 适用于高级链锯剑。击杀后产生电涌，伤害其他实体，并为物品栏中的所有高级工具充能。（Applies to Advanced Chainswords. Cause an electrical surge after killing, damaging other entities and charges all advanced tools in inventory.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.napalm_stream.d: 适用于火焰喷射器。每级提高伤害并延长燃烧时间。增加燃料消耗。（Applies to Flamethrowers. For each level, increases flamethrower damage and fire duration. Increases fuel consumption.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.overdrive.desc: 适用于高级链锯。使用时获得超载效果，提高移动速度和伤害。增加能量消耗。（Applies to Advanced Chainsaws. Grants Overdrive effect when using item, increasing movement speed and damage. Increases energy consumption.）
enchantment.clanginghowl.soul_burner.des: 适用于火焰喷射器。火焰伤害增加 1，并施加短暂的缓慢效果。附近实体被火焰烧死时，为手持的火焰喷射器补充少量燃料。（Applies to Flamethrowers. Increases flame damage by one and inflicts slowness for a short time. Nearby entities dying by fire fuels held flamethrower a bit.）
适用于高级钻机。在未潜行时挖掘 3x3 区域。增加能量消耗。（Applies to Advanced Drills. Dig in a 3x3 area unless sneaking. Increases energy consumption.）

info.clanginghowl.block.former.1: §8启用时，§7地外能量晶体§8会逐渐在其表面生长。生物群系越冷，晶体能够长得越大。§r（§8In an active state, §7Extraterrestrial Energy Crystals §8begin to gradually grow on it. The colder the biome, the larger the crystals can grow.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.barrier.2: §7能量消耗较高，并随你受到的伤害增加。§r（§7Has a high energy consumption that scales with the amount of damage you take.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.boots.3: §7在空中可以进行§6火箭跳跃§7。火箭跳跃会消耗燃料，并使此装置进入短暂冷却。§r（§7You can perform a §6rocket jump §7while in the air. When performing a rocket jump, this gadget will go on a temporary recharge and consume fuel.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.chainsaw.0: §7按住鼠标右键可以快速采掘木质和植物方块。§r（§7Holding the right mouse button allows you to quickly mine wooden and plant blocks.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.chainsword.1: §7攻击对§4机械血肉§7生物造成更高伤害。§r（§7Attacks deal more damage to §4techno-flesh §7creatures.§r）
info.clanginghowl.item.chainsword.2: §7攻击会消耗能量。可使用便携充电器或固定充电站为此工具充能。§r（§7Attacks consume energy. The tool can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.flamethrower.0: §7按住鼠标右键会喷出火焰，焚烧前方的一切。被火焰击中的敌人受到的火焰伤害会提高。§r（§7Holding the right mouse button launches a stream of flame that burns everything in front of it. Enemies hit by the stream of flame take increased fire damage.§r）
info.clanginghowl.item.flamethrower.1: §7每秒使用都会消耗燃料。若物品栏中有§e烈焰燃料罐§7，可以替换燃料罐。§r（§7Every second of use consumes fuel. The fuel cylinder can be replaced if you have a §eBlaze Fuel Cylinder §7in your inventory.§r）
info.clanginghowl.item.glove.2: §7暴击时产生§b电涌§7，造成范围伤害，使所有命中的实体减速，并为你其他的装置和高级工具充入 20 点能量。§r（§7When you perform a critical attack, it creates an §belectrical surge §7that deals area damage, slowing all those hit and charging all your other gadgets and advanced tools by 20 units of energy.§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.reanimator.2: §7复苏器需要充满能量并结束冷却后才能再次工作。可使用便携充电器或固定充电站为其充能§r（§7Reanimator will not be able to work again until it is fully charged and recharged. The gadget can be charged using a portable charger or a stationary charging station§r）

info.clanginghowl.item.tendon.4: §7此装置在疾跑时消耗能量。可使用便携充电器或固定充电站为其充能§r（§7This gadget consume energy while sprinting. The gadget can be charged using a portable charger or a stationary charging station§r）
